Positioning

Where Atlas wins
Against the two incumbents
Atlas AI

Purpose-built agents with your data connected in minutes, not weeks.

Transparent per-task pricing that finance teams can actually forecast.

LegacySuite

Deep install base but 6-month deployment cycles and per-seat pricing.

Strong compliance story; weak on extensibility and API depth.

DIY Stack

Maximum flexibility for teams with dedicated ML engineers.

Total cost of ownership 3–5x higher once maintenance is priced in.

One-line pitch

Atlas AI is the fastest path from "we should use agents" to agents in production —
with pricing, security, and observability that enterprises can sign off on.
